recentItems.title: Pehchaan Episode 35 | Ahsan Khan,  Neelum Muneer | Latest Pakistani Drama
recentItems.description:
Pehchaan Episode 35 is an emotional and powerful Pakistani drama that explores the complicated relationship between love, family loyalty, political rivalry, greed, and personal ambition. 
Starring Ahsan Khan as Chand / Abdullah and Neelum Muneer as Khushi, the drama features an impressive cast including Babar Ali, Saleem Sheikh, Fiza Ali, Nimra Khan, Alyy Khan, Seemi Raheel, and Shabbir Jan.

The story revolves around a powerful political household jahan lalach, siyasi mafadaat aur election ki dushmani ki wajah se family ke andar ke rishte mutasir hone lagte hain. As political rivalry grows stronger, the lives and romantic futures of Chand and Khushi become trapped between family expectations, political interests, and emotional conflicts.

Pehchaan ki kahani dikhati hai ke jab power aur siyasat ke liye apne hi log ek doosre ke khilaf kharay ho jate hain, to iska asar sirf politics tak nahi rehta, balki poore khandan ke rishton aur bachon ke mustaqbil par bhi padta hai.

Chand aur Khushi ke darmiyan mohabbat ka rishta hai, lekin unke aas paas maujood family rivalry aur political conflict unki love story ke liye bari rukawat ban jata hai. Kya Chand aur Khushi apni mohabbat ko khandani siyasat aur election rivalry se bacha payenge? Ya phir power, greed aur family pressure unke mustaqbil ka faisla karega?

The drama explores powerful themes of  love vs. politics, family rivalry, political ambition, greed, sacrifice, betrayal, emotional relationships, and personal freedom. Kabhi kabhi khudgharzi aur siyasi mafadaat ki wajah se log apne hi rishton ko qurban kar dete hain, aur iska nuksan poori family ko uthana padta hai.
